title: An Operational Morphogenetic Code Distance for Tissue-Network Resilience
description: A model-relative weighted vertex-cut framework for structural source–target communication resilience, with cellular-sheaf diagnostics, a pinned-Laplacian theorem, and reproducible synthetic network/inverse-estimation tests. The numerical examples are synthetic; no biological dataset or experimental results are reported. This file is prepared as metadata only and is not a Zenodo deposit or DOI claim.
